notes: Sources opened 2026-10-26. Descriptions paraphrase STScI legacy-instrument and pysynphot documentation; NJM configuration identifiers follow the assigned inventory. The STScI public-domain policy excludes separately marked third-party works; it is not a provenance audit of the existing NJM curve bytes. The HST observing-program acknowledgement is conditional and must not imply that filter calibration curves are science observations. No band-specific magnitude system or detector type is inferred. No inherited SVO references are promoted. Bibliography/passband coverage and configuration-specific provenance remain incomplete; see REPORT.md.
